description: The Pollution Inventory of the Environment Agency collates annual mass releases of specified substances to air, controlled waters and sewers, and quantities of waste transferred off site, from the large industrial sites the Agency regulates in England. It replaced the Chemical Release Inventory in 1998 and is also called the Inventory of Sources and Releases. Every permit for a large industrial site under IPPC, now the Environmental Permitting Regulations, requires annual reporting of a core list of substances, covering the whole permit including fugitive emissions and leaks as well as stacks and other point sources. The data.gov.uk entry offers nine downloadable files covering 2013 to 2024, free of charge; the attribution statement reads Environment Agency copyright and/or database right 2025, all rights reserved, so reuse terms must be checked with the Agency. Caveats: only permitted large sites are included, releases are operator-reported estimates, and years before 2013 are not in these files. For simulation it gives an inventory of regulated industrial sites and their pollutant releases for hazard exposure, environmental impact and emergency planning studies in England. Related catalogue records include the European Industrial Emissions Portal and the EPA Toxics Release Inventory.
